description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing subscription reports within the OpenCart administration interface. It includes functions for displaying subscription reports, saving report settings, and generating subscription data views.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class handling subscription report functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel, including displaying the report interface, saving configuration, and fetching report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the subscription report configuration page with appropriate breadcrumbs, headers, and current settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the subscription report settings, with permission check and AJAX response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the subscription report page, including statuses and grouping options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the subscription report list data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the subscription report data view, including handling filters, pagination, and data formatting.
